patForm.description: Drive the classic Personal Access Token form: open the prefilled URL, set description + expiration through the native input setter, ensure the requested scopes are checked, click Generate, extract the ghp_ token by regex. Stops on a 'Confirm access' sudo re-auth page rather than clicking through it.

expirationLabel.description: visible label to click, default "No expiration"

returns.description: {token} on success; {stop, ...} on sudo / missing scopes / no button / token not found

setOrgAvatar.description: Set an org's avatar via the org profile settings page (no REST/GraphQL endpoint exists for this). Sets the hidden #avatar-upload-input via DOM.setFileInputFiles, then clicks the 'Set new profile picture' button in the crop dialog. dryRun:true stops after locating the input, without uploading.

file.description: absolute path to the image (500x500 PNG verified); required unless dryRun

dryRun.description: stop after finding #avatar-upload-input; do not upload

returns.description: {done:true} on success; {done:false, reason} on no admin access, no input found, or upload/click failure
